id: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides (2011)

facts.text: Barbossa raises his peg leg in a toast.
facts.why: No toast or peg leg raising appears in the transcript or plot. Barbossa does claim Blackbeard's ship and crew and the sword as payment for his lost leg.
facts.fix: Barbossa claims the ship, crew and sword.

vibe.verdict: A solid galley layout with the chalices, mermaid and cream puff all in, though the food names are generic.
missing: Jack's chandelier escape with a cream puff (St James's Palace)
The Captain's Daughter tavern duel with the fake Jack (London)
Blackbeard's sword controlling the ropes (Queen Anne's Revenge)
The poisoned sword and the poisonous toads (finale)
ideas: Swap 'London tavern beef and gravy pies' for 'Captain's Daughter tavern pies', the tavern's real name.
Swap 'Spanish expedition olives' for 'Palace cream puffs on the chandelier'.
Swap the sherry house line for a poisoned toad cocktail mocktail.
Swap 'Whitecap Bay prawns' note for 'Mermaids, keep your hands inside the boat'.
